description: The user copy sits on a disk after the Atoll copy's: --move-originals still moves it first, and the first copy made is the one that stands in for it.
config:
pool_id = "p"
catalog = "${SANDBOX}/catalog.db"
[view]

uuid = "3f1c9a2e-5b7d-4c1e-9a0b-2d4f6e8a1c3b"
mount = "${SANDBOX}/disks/t1"
fs = "ext4"
tags = ["sata"]
